prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1282
Claimant:
George Booker
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
2023-11-26
Claim reported by phone today. Insured states a vehicle was struck while parked in a store parking lot and the other
driver left the scene before exchanging details.
2023-12-14
Spoke with the insured's household driver, who was operating the vehicle at the time. The account matches the initial
report, and the driver says a bumper was pushed in on the rear passenger side.
2023-12-21
Obtained the police report reference. Officers attended the lot and recorded the statements of two witnesses who saw
the collision and confirmed the claimant was seated in the vehicle when it happened.
2023-12-29
Photos from the scene and the insured's phone were received. The damage shown on the rear quarter panel and
bumper is consistent with the impact described by everyone so far.
2024-01-16
Claimant is now represented by counsel. All future contact will go through the attorney's office, and a letter of
representation has been placed in the file.
2024-01-18
Counsel's office sent a demand package listing neck and lower back complaints. Records requested from the first
treating provider; it is not yet clear whether the back injury stems from this crash or from another source.
2024-02-10
Reviewed the treatment records. Care followed a typical course of physical therapy and medication, and symptoms
eased steadily as the claimant improved. No earlier injury to the same body area appears in the records we have.
2024-03-15
Spoke with the other driver, who independently confirmed the sequence of events and the position of both vehicles.
Nothing in that account conflicts with the physical damage or the witness statements.
2024-04-17
Vehicle inspected at the repair facility. Estimator found no earlier damage to the vehicle and no prior repair records
surfaced in the database check. The findings line up with the described impact.
2024-05-19
Confirmed the policy was active on the date of loss and that the driver is a household member of the policyholder and
therfeore covered. Nothing points to any damage occurring before coverage began.
2024-05-30
Counsel was asked for prior medical history and wage documentation. Claimant has given the same account of the
collision in every conversation to date, and no inconsistencies have been noted.
2024-06-02
Injury evaluation remains open pending the treating doctor's final note and the records review. Reserves are being
kept at the current level until the medical causation question is resolved.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
